mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate below 4.8% indicates a tight labor market that supports corporate profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE is below 4.8%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales signal robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns through stronger economic growth.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both rise >0.5% in prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when both HOUST and RSAFS increase by >0.5% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO declines >0.3% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts indicates strong residential construction activity, generating positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns across all economic regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when HOUST is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 2.5% annualized signals rising inflation that triggers monetary tightening expectations, producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when CPIAUCSL rises above 2.5% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth coupled with falling unemployment indicates a tightening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns through elevated corporate earnings.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases >0.5% and UNRATE falls >0.2pp in prior month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when PAYEMS increases >0.5% and UNRATE falls >0.2pp in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansions, a rise in retail sales above 1.0% signals accelerating consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In early-cycle expansion periods, SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when RSAFS rises >1.0% in the prior month.
